subject: Case study: quick check on SOC 2 / ISO line

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>

Cc: 
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Case study: quick check on SOC 2 / ISO line

Hi Clara,

Thanks again for the great demo last week — the metrics you shared around inference latency improvements are exactly the kind of customer story we'd like to highlight. We put together a short draft case study (attached) and wanted to run one compliance-related line by you before we publish.

Specifically, we're planning to include a one-line note in the "Security & Compliance" sidebar that summarizes Solstice's posture as it relates to working with Redwood. Here's the suggested sentence from our comms team:

  "Solstice Health integrates Redwood Inference under its existing security controls; Redwood has a SOC 2 Type II report and ISO 27001 certification in scope for hosted deployments."

Quick asks:
- Would you be comfortable with that wording (we can shorten it)?
- If not, would your legal or security team prefer a different phrasing or require citation to a specific report date?

I've attached the draft case study and a short SOC 2 summary we plan to link to from the sidebar. If it's helpful, I'm happy to propose two alternative one-liners (short/long).

If you can point me to the appropriate person on your side (legal/security), I'll loop them in. Happy to wait for final sign-off before we publish anything public.

Best,

Jonas Weber
Head of Growth
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0198

Attachments: redwood-case-draft-v1.docx, solstice-soc2-summary.pdf

From: Clara Ruiz <clara.ruiz@solstice.io>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Legal Ops <legal@solstice.io>
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Case study: quick check on SOC 2 / ISO line

Hi Jonas — thanks for sending this over and for the thoughtful draft. The case study looks good overall. For the security line, we need to run a short legal/security check, but I can share preliminary feedback from our compliance lead: they prefer we avoid the word "certification" without a specific certificate reference, and they want the SOC 2 statement to include the report date.

They suggested this tweak as a starting point:

  "Solstice Health partners with Redwood Inference; Redwood attested to SOC 2 Type II (report dated March 2026) and maintains ISO 27001 controls for hosted services."

I'm looping in Legal Ops so they can confirm the exact report title and whether a public PDF is okay to link. We'll take a quick look and aim to get you an answer by EOD Monday.

Best,
Clara Ruiz
Head of Product, Solstice Health
clara.ruiz@solstice.io

Hi Clara / Legal Ops team,

Thanks for the quick initial notes, Clara. I'm Lauren (legal at Redwood) — copying Grace from comms. A couple of clarifying points from our side so we can land on a mutually acceptable short sentence in the public case study:

1) If you permit a link to our SOC 2 report, we can point to a short public summary PDF and include the report month/year exactly as you request.
2) We avoid using the word "certification" for SOC 2 since SOC 2 is an attestation; using "attested" or "maintains" is accurate. If you prefer "assessment" or "attested to" we can adopt your exact phrasing.
3) For ISO 27001 we can either say "ISO 27001 controls in scope" or "ISO 27001-aligned controls" — whichever matches your legal preference.

Proposed two alternatives for you to pick from (short/long):

Short: "Solstice Health partners with Redwood Inference; Redwood attested to SOC 2 Type II (March 2026)."

Long: "Solstice Health partners with Redwood Inference; Redwood attested to SOC 2 Type II (report dated March 2026) and maintains ISO 27001-aligned controls for hosted services."

If you can confirm which variant you'd like (and whether linking to a PDF is fine), we'll finalize the sidebar copy and push the updated draft back to Jonas.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood-case-draft-v1-comments.pdf

From: Legal Ops <legal@solstice.io>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Clara Ruiz <clara.ruiz@solstice.io>
Date: Mon, 8 Jun 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Case study: quick check on SOC 2 / ISO line

Hi Lauren / Jonas / Grace — thanks for reaching out. On behalf of Solstice Legal Ops: we confirm the SOC 2 attestation reference is fine with the March 2026 date included. We prefer the Long variant with a small edit to the ISO wording. Final approved sentence below:

  "Solstice Health partners with Redwood Inference; Redwood attested to SOC 2 Type II (report dated March 2026) and maintains ISO 27001-aligned controls for its hosted services."

Linking to Redwood's public SOC 2 summary PDF is acceptable. Please include a short note in the case study that the SOC 2 report is a third-party attestation and is subject to the report's scope and timeframe.

You have our approval to publish the case study with that sentence. Please send us a final pre-publish copy for courtesy review before it goes live.

Regards,
Legal Ops Team
Solstice Health
legal@solstice.io
